senses.gloss:
m. (-भः)
A kind of snake, one which is described as not venomous^1.
E.
द्रुभ to sink, Uṇādi affix उभ, deriv. irr.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Destroyed or annihilated with trouble or difficulty.
E.
दुर before, णश to destroy, deriv. irr.
